overachievers.name: The Overachievers
overachievers.desc: Always striving for perfection, this group dominates honor roll, student council, and every academic competition.

creatives.name: The Creatives
creatives.desc: A mix of artists, musicians, and writers who express themselves through every medium possible, from sketchbooks to theater performances.

athletes.name: The Athletes
athletes.desc: From varsity stars to gym rats, this clique lives for competition, teamwork, and the next big game.

gamers.name: The Gamers & Tech Wizards
gamers.desc: Obsessed with video games, coding, and the latest tech trends, they can be found debating over frame rates or hacking their school's Wi-Fi (for educational purposes, of course).

rebels.name: The Rebels
rebels.desc: The rule-breakers and trendsetters who thrive on being different. They challenge authority, question the status quo, and have the best taste in underground music.

socials.name: The Social Butterflies
socials.desc: They know everyone and are always at the center of the latest gossip, party planning, and social media trends.

chill.name: The Chill Outsiders
chill.desc: A laid-back group that doesn't fit into any one category. They do their own thing, whether it's skateboarding, watching obscure movies, or just hanging out.
